frozen_inputs.scoring: L2-normalised patch tokens -> cosine 1-NN -> max over 1024 patches

B1.op: 3x3 avg-pool over 32x32 patch grid, then L2-norm

B2.op: 5x5 avg-pool over 32x32 patch grid, then L2-norm

C1.op: concat(448 last-layer, 224 last-layer upsampled 16x16->32x32) then L2-norm

C2.op: concat(448 last-layer, 336 last-layer upsampled 24x24->32x32) then L2-norm

notes: get_intermediate_layers(n=5, norm=True) returns blocks 7..11 (LayerNorm applied, no CLS token).
Multi-scale uses the l0_448 cache resized to 224/336 (documented 2-stage resize vs original 1024).
No learned params, no test-set tuning, no threshold selection.
